nodes.en: As we can see, the kernel is simple. It first divides the work among threads by calculating the starting point of the output subarray to be produced by the current thread (k_curr) and that of the next thread (k_next). Keep in mind that the total number of output elements may not be a multiple of the number of threads. Each thread then makes two calls to the co-rank function. The first call uses k_curr as the rank parameter, which is the first (lowest-indexed) element of the output subarray that the current thread is to generate. The returned co-rank value, i_curr, gives the lowest-indexed input A array element that belongs to the input subarray to be used by the thread. This co-rank value can also be used to get j_curr for the B input subarray. The i_curr and j_curr values mark the beginning of the input subarrays for the thread. Therefore &A[i_curr] and &B[j_curr] are the pointers to the beginning of the input subarrays to be used by the current thread.
nodes.zh: 可以看到，这个核函数很简单。它首先计算当前线程要生成的输出子数组的起始点（k_curr）和下一个线程的输出子数组起始点（k_next），从而在线程之间划分工作。请记住，输出元素的总数可能不是线程数的整数倍。然后，每个线程对协秩函数进行两次调用。第一次调用使用 k_curr 作为秩参数，k_curr 是当前线程要生成的输出子数组的第一个（索引最小的）元素。返回的协秩值 i_curr 给出属于该线程要使用的输入子数组的、索引最小的输入 A 数组元素。这个协秩值还可以用来得到 B 输入子数组的 j_curr。i_curr 和 j_curr 的值标明了该线程输入子数组的起始位置。因此，&A[i_curr] 和 &B[j_curr] 是指向当前线程要使用的输入子数组起始位置的指针。

nodes.en: The second call uses k_next as the rank parameter to get the co-rank values for the next thread. These co-rank values mark the positions of the lowest-indexed input array elements to be used by the next thread. Therefore i_next − i_curr and j_next − j_curr give the sizes of the subarrays of A and B to be used by the current thread. The pointer to the beginning of the output subarray to be produced by the current thread is &C[k_curr]. The final step of the kernel is to call the merge_sequential function (from 【1】Fig. 12.2【/1】) with these parameters.
nodes.zh: 第二次调用使用 k_next 作为秩参数，以获得下一个线程的协秩值。这些协秩值标明了下一个线程要使用的索引最小的输入数组元素的位置。因此，i_next − i_curr 和 j_next − j_curr 给出当前线程要使用的 A 和 B 子数组的大小。指向当前线程要生成的输出子数组起始位置的指针是 &C[k_curr]。核函数的最后一步是使用这些参数调用归并函数 merge_sequential（来自【1】图 12.2【/1】）。

nodes.en: The execution of the basic merge kernel can be illustrated with the example in 【1】Fig. 12.8【/1】. The k_curr values for the three threads (threads 0, 1, and 2) will be 0, 3, and 6. We will focus on the execution of thread 1 whose k_curr value will be 3. The i_curr and j_curr values determined from the first co-rank function call are 2 and 1. The k_next value for thread 1 will be 6. The second call to the co-rank function helps determine the i_next and j_next values of 5 and 1. Thread 1 then calls the merge function with parameters (&A[2], 3, &B[1], 0, &C[3]). Note that the 0 value for parameter n indicates that none of the three elements of the output subarray for thread 1 should come from array B. This is indeed the case in 【2】Fig. 12.8【/2】: output elements C[3]−C[5] all come from A[2]−A[4].
nodes.zh: 基础归并核函数的执行可以用【1】图 12.8【/1】中的示例来说明。三个线程（线程 0、1 和 2）的 k_curr 值将是 0、3 和 6。我们将重点关注 k_curr 值为 3 的线程 1 的执行。从第一次协秩函数调用确定的 i_curr 和 j_curr 值是 2 和 1。线程 1 的 k_next 值将是 6。对协秩函数的第二次调用有助于确定 i_next 和 j_next 的值，即 5 和 1。然后，线程 1 以参数 (&A[2], 3, &B[1], 0, &C[3]) 调用归并函数。注意，参数 n 的值 0 表示线程 1 的输出子数组的三个元素都不应来自数组 B。【2】图 12.8【/2】中的情况正是如此：输出元素 C[3]−C[5] 全部来自 A[2]−A[4]。

nodes.en: While the basic merge kernel is quite simple and elegant, it falls short in memory access efficiency. First, it is clear that when executing the merge_sequential function, adjacent threads in a warp are not accessing adjacent memory locations when they read and write the input and output subarray elements. For the example in 【1】Fig. 12.8【/1】, during the first iteration of the merge_sequential function execution, the three adjacent threads would read A[0], A[2], and B[0]. They will then write to C[0], C[3], and C[6]. Thus their memory accesses are not coalesced, resulting in poor utilization of memory bandwidth.
nodes.zh: 虽然基础归并核函数相当简单而优雅，但它在内存访问效率方面有所不足。首先，显然在执行归并函数 merge_sequential 时，线程束中的相邻线程在读写输入和输出子数组元素时访问的不是相邻的内存位置。以【1】图 12.8【/1】中的示例为例，在归并函数 merge_sequential 执行的第一次迭代中，三个相邻线程将读取 A[0]、A[2] 和 B[0]。然后它们将写入 C[0]、C[3] 和 C[6]。因此，它们的内存访问不是合并的，导致内存带宽利用率低下。

nodes.en: Second, the threads also need to access A and B elements from the global memory when they execute the co-rank function. Since the co-rank function does a binary search, the access patterns are somewhat irregular and will be unlikely to be coalesced. As a result, these accesses can further reduce the efficiency of utilizing the memory bandwidth. It would be helpful if we can avoid these uncoalesced accesses to the global memory by the co-rank function.
nodes.zh: 其次，线程在执行协秩函数时还需要从全局内存访问 A 和 B 元素。由于协秩函数执行二分查找，其访问模式有些不规则，不太可能是合并的。因此，这些访问会进一步降低内存带宽的利用效率。如果我们能避免协秩函数对全局内存的这些非合并访问，将会很有帮助。

nodes.en: 12.6 A tiled merge kernel to improve coalescing
nodes.zh: 12.6 改善合并访问的分块归并核函数

nodes.en: In 【1】Chapter 6【/1】, Performance Considerations, we mentioned three main strategies for improving memory coalescing in kernels: (1) rearranging the mapping of threads to data, (2) rearranging the data itself, and (3) transferring the data between the global memory and the shared memory in a coalesced manner and performing the irregular accesses in the shared memory. For the merge pattern we will use the third strategy, which leverages shared memory to improve coalescing. Using shared memory also has the advantage of capturing the small amount of data reuse across the co-rank functions and the sequential merge phase.
nodes.zh: 在【1】第 6 章【/1】（性能考量）中，我们提到了在核函数中改善内存合并的三种主要策略：（1）重新排列线程到数据的映射；（2）重新排列数据本身；（3）以合并的方式在全局内存与共享内存之间传输数据，并在共享内存中执行不规则的访问。对于归并模式，我们将采用第三种策略，即利用共享内存来改善合并访问。使用共享内存还有一个优点，即能够利用协秩函数与串行归并阶段之间的少量数据重用。

nodes.en: The key observation is that the input A and B subarrays to be used by the adjacent threads are adjacent to each other in memory. Essentially, all threads in a block will collectively use larger, block-level subarrays of A and B to generate a larger, block-level subarray of C. We can call the co-rank function for the entire block to get the starting and ending locations for the block-level A and B subarrays. Using these block-level co-rank values, all threads in the block can cooperatively load the elements of the block-level A and B subarrays into the shared memory in a coalesced pattern.
nodes.zh: 关键的观察是：相邻线程要使用的 A 和 B 输入子数组在内存中是彼此相邻的。本质上，线程块中的所有线程将共同使用较大的、线程块级的 A 和 B 子数组，来生成一个较大的、线程块级的 C 子数组。我们可以为整个线程块调用协秩函数，以获得线程块级 A 和 B 子数组的起始和结束位置。利用这些线程块级协秩值，线程块中的所有线程可以协作地、以合并的模式把线程块级 A 和 B 子数组的元素加载到共享内存中。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.10【/1】 shows the block-level design of a tiled merge kernel. In this example, we assume that three blocks will be used for the merge operation. At the bottom of the figure, we show that C is partitioned into three block-level subarrays. We delineate these partitions with gray vertical bars. On the basis of the partition, each block calls the co-rank functions to partition the input array into subarrays to be used for each block. We also delineate the input partitions with gray vertical bars. Note that the input partitions can vary significantly in size according to the actual data element values in the input arrays. For example, in 【2】Fig. 12.8【/2】 the input A subarray is significantly larger than the input B subarray for thread 0. On the other hand, the input A subarray is significantly smaller than the input B subarray for thread 1. Obviously, the combined size of the two input subarrays must always be equal to the size of the output subarray for each thread.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.10【/1】展示了分块归并核函数的线程块级设计。在此示例中，我们假设使用三个线程块执行归并操作。在图的底部，我们展示了 C 被划分为三个线程块级子数组。我们用灰色竖条标出这些划分。基于该划分，每个线程块调用协秩函数，把输入数组划分为供每个线程块使用的子数组。我们也用灰色竖条标出输入划分。注意，根据输入数组中实际数据元素的值，输入划分的大小可以有很大差异。例如，在【2】图 12.8【/2】中，线程 0 的输入 A 子数组明显大于输入 B 子数组。另一方面，线程 1 的输入 A 子数组明显小于输入 B 子数组。显然，两个输入子数组的大小之和必须始终等于每个线程的输出子数组的大小。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.10【/1】 Design of a tiled merge kernel.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.10【/1】 分块归并核函数的设计。

nodes.en: We will declare two shared memory arrays A_S and B_S for each block. Owing to the limited shared memory size, A_S and B_S may not be able to cover the entire input subarrays for the block. Therefore we will take an iterative approach. Assume that the A_S and B_S arrays can each hold x elements, while each output subarray contains y elements. Each thread block will perform its operation in y/x iterations. During each iteration, all threads in a block will cooperatively load x elements from the block’s input A subarray and x elements from its input B subarray.
nodes.zh: 我们将为每个线程块声明两个共享内存数组 A_S 和 B_S。由于共享内存大小有限，A_S 和 B_S 可能无法覆盖线程块的整个输入子数组。因此，我们将采用迭代方法。假设 A_S 和 B_S 数组各自能容纳 x 个元素，而每个输出子数组包含 y 个元素。每个线程块将在 y/x 次迭代中完成其操作。在每次迭代中，线程块中的所有线程将协作地从线程块的输入 A 子数组加载 x 个元素，并从其输入 B 子数组加载 x 个元素。

nodes.en: The first iteration of each thread is illustrated in 【1】Fig. 12.10【/1】. We show that for each block, a light gray section of the input A subarray is loaded into A_S, and a light gray section of the input B subarray is loaded into B_S. With x A elements and x B elements in the shared memory, the thread block has enough input elements to generate at least x output array elements. All threads are guaranteed to have all the input subarray elements they need for the iteration. One might ask why loading a total of 2x input elements can guarantee the generation of only x output elements. The reason is that in the worst case, all elements of the current output section may all come from one of the input sections. This uncertainty of input usage makes the tiling design for the merge kernel much more challenging than the previous patterns. One can be more accurate in loading the input tiles by first calling the co-rank function for the current and next output sections. In this case, we pay an additional binary search operation to save on redundant data loading. We leave this alternative implementation as an exercise. We will also increase the efficiency of memory bandwidth utilization with a circular buffer design in 【2】Section 12.7【/2】.
nodes.zh: 每个线程的第一次迭代如【1】图 12.10【/1】所示。我们展示了：对于每个线程块，输入 A 子数组的浅灰色部分被加载到 A_S 中，输入 B 子数组的浅灰色部分被加载到 B_S 中。共享内存中有 x 个 A 元素和 x 个 B 元素时，线程块就有足够的输入元素来生成至少 x 个输出数组元素。所有线程都能保证获得本次迭代所需的全部输入子数组元素。有人可能会问，为什么加载总共 2x 个输入元素只能保证生成 x 个输出元素。原因在于：在最坏的情况下，当前输出区段的所有元素可能全部来自其中一个输入区段。这种输入使用的不确定性使归并核函数的分块设计比之前的模式更具挑战性。可以先为当前和下一个输出区段调用协秩函数，从而更精确地加载输入分块。在这种情况下，我们以额外的二分查找操作换取冗余数据加载的减少。我们把这个替代实现留作练习。在【2】第 12.7 节【/2】中，我们还将通过环形缓冲区设计来提高内存带宽的利用效率。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.10【/1】 also shows that threads in each block will use a portion of the A_S and a portion of the B_S in each iteration, shown as dark gray sections, to generate a section of x elements in their output C subarray. This process is illustrated with the dotted arrows going from the A_S and B_S dark gray sections to the C dark gray sections. Note that each thread block may well use a different portion of its A_S versus B_S sections. Some blocks may use more elements from A_S, and others may use more from B_S. The actual portions that are used by each block depend on the input data element values.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.10【/1】还展示了：每个线程块中的线程在每次迭代中将使用 A_S 的一部分和 B_S 的一部分（以深灰色区段示出），以在其输出 C 子数组中生成一个包含 x 个元素的区段。这一过程用从 A_S 和 B_S 深灰色区段指向 C 深灰色区段的虚线箭头来说明。注意，每个线程块使用的 A_S 与 B_S 部分很可能各不相同。有些线程块可能从 A_S 使用更多元素，另一些则可能从 B_S 使用更多元素。每个线程块实际使用的部分取决于输入数据元素的值。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.11【/1】 shows the first part of a tiled merge kernel. A comparison against 【2】Fig. 12.9【/2】 shows remarkable similarity. This part is essentially the block-level version of the setup code for the thread-level basic merge kernel. Only one thread in the block needs to calculate the co-rank values for the rank values of the beginning output index of the current block and that of the beginning output index of the next block. The values are placed into the shared memory so that they can be visible to all threads in the block. Having only one thread to call the co-rank functions reduces the number of global memory accesses by the co-rank functions and should improve the efficiency of the global memory accesses. A barrier synchronization is used to ensure that all threads wait until the block-level co-rank values are available in the shared memory A_S[0] and A_S[1] locations before they proceed to use the values.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.11【/1】展示了分块归并核函数的第一部分。与【2】图 12.9【/2】相比，二者显示出惊人的相似性。这部分本质上就是线程级基础归并核函数设置代码的线程块级版本。线程块中只需要一个线程为当前线程块起始输出索引的秩值和下一个线程块起始输出索引的秩值计算协秩值。这些值被放入共享内存，以便线程块中的所有线程都能看到。只让一个线程调用协秩函数，可以减少协秩函数的全局内存访问次数，从而改善全局内存访问的效率。这里使用屏障同步来确保所有线程等待线程块级协秩值出现在共享内存的 A_S[0] 和 A_S[1] 位置后，才继续使用这些值。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.11【/1】 Part 1: Identifying block-level output and input subarrays.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.11【/1】 第 1 部分：确定线程块级输出和输入子数组。

nodes.en: Recall that since the input subarrays may be too large to fit into the shared memory, the kernel takes an iterative approach. The kernel receives a tile_size argument that specifies the number of A elements and B elements to be accommodated in the shared memory. For example, a tile_size value of 1024 means that 1024 A array elements and 1024 B array elements are to be accommodated in the shared memory. This means that each block will dedicate (1024 + 1024)×4=8192 bytes of shared memory to hold the A and B array elements.
nodes.zh: 回想一下，由于输入子数组可能太大而无法放入共享内存，核函数采用迭代方法。核函数接收一个 tile_size 参数，它指定共享内存要容纳的 A 元素和 B 元素的数量。例如，tile_size 的值为 1024 表示共享内存要容纳 1024 个 A 数组元素和 1024 个 B 数组元素。这意味着每个线程块将分配 (1024 + 1024)×4=8192 字节的共享内存来存放 A 和 B 数组元素。

nodes.en: As a simple example, assume that we would like to merge an A array of 33,000 elements (m=33,000) with a B array of 31,000 elements (n=31,000). The total number of output C elements is 64,000. Further assume that we will use 16 blocks (gridDim.x=16) and 128 threads in each block (blockDim.x=128). Each block will generate 64,000/16=4000 output C array elements.
nodes.zh: 举一个简单的例子：假设我们要把包含 33,000 个元素的数组 A（m=33,000）与包含 31,000 个元素的数组 B（n=31,000）归并。输出 C 元素的总数为 64,000。进一步假设我们使用 16 个线程块（gridDim.x=16），每个线程块有 128 个线程（blockDim.x=128）。每个线程块将生成 64,000/16=4000 个输出 C 数组元素。

nodes.en: If we assume that the tile_size value is 1024, the while-loop in 【1】Fig. 12.12【/1】 will need to take four iterations for each block to complete the generation of its 4000 output elements. During iteration 0 of the while-loop, the threads in each block will cooperatively load 1024 elements of A and 1024 elements of B into the shared memory. Since there are 128 threads in a block, they can collectively load 128 elements in each iteration of the for-loop (line 26). So the first for-loop in 【2】Fig. 12.12【/2】 will iterate 8 times for all threads in a block to complete the loading of the 1024 A elements. The second for-loop will also iterate 8 times to complete the loading the 1024 B elements. Note that threads use their threadIdx.x values to select the element to load, so consecutive threads load consecutive elements. The memory accesses are coalesced. We will come back later and explain the if-conditions and how the index expressions for loading the A and B elements are formulated.
nodes.zh: 如果我们假设 tile_size 的值为 1024，【1】图 12.12【/1】中的 while 循环需要对每个线程块进行四次迭代，才能完成其 4000 个输出元素的生成。在 while 循环的第 0 次迭代期间，每个线程块中的线程将协作地把 1024 个 A 元素和 1024 个 B 元素加载到共享内存中。由于一个线程块有 128 个线程，它们在 for 循环（第 26 行）的每次迭代中可以共同加载 128 个元素。因此，【2】图 12.12【/2】中的第一个 for 循环将迭代 8 次，线程块中的所有线程才能完成 1024 个 A 元素的加载。第二个 for 循环也将迭代 8 次，以完成 1024 个 B 元素的加载。注意，线程使用其 threadIdx.x 值来选择要加载的元素，因此连续的线程加载连续的元素。这些内存访问是合并的。稍后我们将回过头来解释这些 if 条件，以及用于加载 A 和 B 元素的索引表达式是如何构造的。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.12【/1】 Part 2: Loading A and B elements into the shared memory.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.12【/1】 第 2 部分：将 A 和 B 元素加载到共享内存中。

nodes.en: Once the input tiles are in the shared memory, individual threads can divide up the input tiles and merge their portions in parallel. This is done by assigning a section of the output to each thread and running the co-rank function to determine the sections of shared memory data that should be used for generating that output section. The code in 【1】Fig. 12.13【/1】 completes this step. Keep in mind that this is a continuation of the while-loop that started in 【2】Fig. 12.12【/2】. During each iteration of the while-loop, threads in a block will generate a total of tile_size C elements, using the data that we loaded into shared memory. (The exception is the last iteration, which will be addressed later.) The co-rank function is run on the data in shared memory for individual threads. Each thread first calculates the starting position of its output range and that of the next thread and then uses these starting positions as the inputs to the co-rank function to identify its input ranges. Each thread will then call the sequential merge function to merge its portions of A and B elements (identified by the co-rank values) from the shared memory into its designated range of C elements.
nodes.zh: 一旦输入分块进入共享内存，各个线程就可以划分输入分块并并行归并各自的部分。具体做法是：把输出的一个区段分配给每个线程，并运行协秩函数来确定应使用哪些共享内存数据区段来生成该输出区段。【1】图 12.13【/1】中的代码完成了这一步。请记住，这是【2】图 12.12【/2】中开始的 while 循环的延续。在 while 循环的每次迭代中，线程块中的线程将使用我们加载到共享内存中的数据，生成总共 tile_size 个 C 元素。（最后那次迭代除外，稍后会加以说明。）协秩函数针对各个线程在共享内存中的数据运行。每个线程首先计算其输出范围的起始位置和下一个线程输出范围的起始位置，然后把这些起始位置作为协秩函数的输入，以确定其输入范围。然后，每个线程调用串行归并函数，把（由协秩值确定的）其 A 和 B 元素部分从共享内存归并到其指定的 C 元素范围中。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.13【/1】 Part 3: All threads merge their individual subarrays in parallel.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.13【/1】 第 3 部分：所有线程并行归并各自的子数组。

nodes.en: Let us resume our running example. In each iteration of the while-loop, all threads in a block will be collectively generating 1024 output elements, using the two input tiles of A and B elements in the shared memory. (Once again, we will deal with the last iteration of the while-loop later.) The work is divided among 128 threads, so each thread will be generating eight output elements. While we know that each thread will consume a total of eight input elements in the shared memory, we need to call the co-rank function to find out the exact number of A elements versus B elements that each thread will consume and their start and end locations. For example, one thread may use three A elements and five B elements, while another may use six A elements and two B elements, and so on.
nodes.zh: 让我们继续我们正在进行的示例。在 while 循环的每次迭代中，线程块中的所有线程将使用共享内存中的两个输入分块（A 元素和 B 元素）共同生成 1024 个输出元素。（再次说明，我们稍后会处理 while 循环的最后一次迭代。）工作在 128 个线程之间划分，因此每个线程将生成八个输出元素。虽然我们知道每个线程将消耗共享内存中总共八个输入元素，但我们仍需要调用协秩函数来确定每个线程将消耗的 A 元素与 B 元素的确切数量以及它们的起始和结束位置。例如，一个线程可能使用三个 A 元素和五个 B 元素，另一个线程可能使用六个 A 元素和两个 B 元素，依此类推。

nodes.en: Collectively, the total number of A elements and B elements that are used by all threads in a block for the iteration will add up to 1024 in our example. For example, if all threads in a block use 476 A elements, we know that they also used 1024 − 476=548 B elements. It may even be possible that all threads end up using 1024 A elements and 0 B elements. Keep in mind that a total of 2048 elements are loaded in the shared memory. Therefore in each iteration of the while-loop, only half of the A and B elements that were loaded into the shared memory will be used by all the threads in the block.
nodes.zh: 总的来说，在我们这个示例中，线程块中所有线程在该次迭代中使用的 A 元素和 B 元素总数将加起来等于 1024。例如，如果线程块中的所有线程使用了 476 个 A 元素，我们就知道它们还使用了 1024 − 476=548 个 B 元素。甚至有可能所有线程最终使用 1024 个 A 元素和 0 个 B 元素。请记住，共享内存中总共加载了 2048 个元素。因此，在 while 循环的每次迭代中，加载到共享内存中的 A 和 B 元素只有一半会被线程块中的所有线程使用。

nodes.en: We are now ready to examine more details of the kernel function. Recall that we skipped the explanation of the index expressions for loading the A and B elements from the global memory into the shared memory. For each iteration of the while-loop, the starting point for loading the current tile in the A and B array depends on the total number of A and B elements that have been consumed by all threads of the block during the previous iterations of the while-loop. Assume that we keep track of the total number of A elements that were consumed by all the previous iterations of the while-loop in variable A_consumed. We initialize A_consumed to 0 before entering the while-loop. During iteration 0 of the while-loop, all blocks start their tiles from A[A_curr] since A_consumed is 0 at the beginning of iteration 0. During each subsequent iteration of the while-loop, the tile of A elements will start at A[A_curr + A_consumed].
nodes.zh: 现在我们可以更仔细地考察核函数的细节了。回想一下，我们跳过了关于把 A 和 B 元素从全局内存加载到共享内存的索引表达式的解释。对于 while 循环的每次迭代，在 A 和 B 数组中加载当前分块的起始点取决于 while 循环此前各次迭代中线程块所有线程已消耗的 A 和 B 元素总数。假设我们用变量 A_consumed 记录 while 循环此前所有迭代消耗的 A 元素总数。在进入 while 循环之前，我们把 A_consumed 初始化为 0。在 while 循环的第 0 次迭代中，由于迭代 0 开始时 A_consumed 为 0，所有线程块都从 A[A_curr] 开始加载其分块。在 while 循环随后的每次迭代中，A 元素分块将从 A[A_curr + A_consumed] 开始。

nodes.en: 【1】Fig. 12.14【/1】 illustrates the index calculation for iteration 1 of the while-loop. In our running example in 【2】Fig. 12.10【/2】 we show the A_S elements that are consumed by the block of threads during iteration 0 as the dark gray portion of the tile in A_S. During iteration 1 the tile to be loaded from the global memory for block 0 should start at the location right after the section that contains the A elements consumed in iteration 0. In 【3】Fig. 12.14【/3】, for each block, the section of A elements that is consumed in iteration 0 is shown as the small white section at the beginning of the A subarray (marked by the vertical bars) assigned to the block. Since the length of the small section is given by the value of A_consumed, the tile to be loaded for iteration 1 of the while-loop starts at A[A_curr + A_consumed]. Similarly, the tile to be loaded for iteration 1 of the while-loop starts at B[B_curr + B_consumed].
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.14【/1】展示了 while 循环第 1 次迭代的索引计算。在我们【2】图 12.10【/2】中的示例里，我们把线程块在第 0 次迭代期间消耗的 A_S 元素显示为 A_S 中分块的深灰色部分。在第 1 次迭代中，线程块 0 要从全局内存加载的分块应起始于包含第 0 次迭代所消耗 A 元素的区段之后紧邻的位置。在【3】图 12.14【/3】中，对于每个线程块，第 0 次迭代消耗的 A 元素区段显示为分配给该线程块的 A 子数组开头的小白色区段（由竖条标出）。由于这个小区段的长度由 A_consumed 的值给出，while 循环第 1 次迭代要加载的分块从 A[A_curr + A_consumed] 开始。同样，while 循环第 1 次迭代要加载的分块从 B[B_curr + B_consumed] 开始。
